cand.title: HR Level Up 2027
cand.excerpt: Event evidence is strong; ranking is reduced where the venue is committed or hotel sourcing is unconfirmed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Verified organizer-side relationship contacts, not verified hotel buyers: Rahel Alvarez, responsible for administration and accounting at HR Genève, is the first routing contact; Carola Oeuvray, HR Genève vice-president and listed with Palexpo SA, bridges association governance and the incumbent venue; Robert Tanner, HR Genève president, is the escalation contact for partnership strategy. Public committee-page emails are supplied below. No evidence establishes that any individual controls accommodation contracts.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced for Thursday 27 May 2027, 08:00–14:00, at Palexpo, Le Grand-Saconnex, Switzerland. This is an activity date within the requested horizon, not an article date. Theme: Éthique RH, le courage d’être humain. Ticket sales are announced to open 27 November 2026. The official programme page independently confirms the date. No later edition was identified; do not create a 2028 edition from recurrence.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications: YOTEL Geneva Lake is a Founex meeting hotel, not a downtown hotel or a resort-led destination. The airport-corridor venue gives geographic plausibility, but no event-specific lodging toward Founex/La Côte is evidenced. The regional HR audience and 08:00–14:00 format suggest limited overnight demand; this is not a published room estimate. Only a specifically identified speaker, organizer or nonlocal-attendee subset could support ancillary accommodation. Historical 2023 attendance was reported as 300, exceeding the supplied approximately 250-theatre capacity; 2025 attendance was reported only as more than 200, which does not establish that it would fit. Do not pitch relocation of the announced congress or assume banquet capacity. A separately commissioned smaller workshop could fit the six-room meeting product, but none is currently sourced.
findings.venueCommitments: Published venue: Palexpo, Route François-Peyrot, Le Grand-Saconnex, canton of Geneva, Switzerland; historical practical information specifies number 30. Territory: Geneva Airport corridor, not Founex/Nyon/La Côte and not downtown Geneva. Palexpo is an exhibition/congress venue, not an incumbent hotel. The organizer has announced the venue; the underlying venue contract and room/hall allocation are not public. Palexpo describes itself as a ten-minute walk from Geneva Airport. This proves airport accessibility, not that delegates fly in or stay near La Côte.
findings.historicalRotation: 1 June 2023: first edition, Palexpo, Le Grand-Saconnex, 08:00–14:00, within The Future of Work and Learning Event. 12 June 2025: second edition, same venue and hours. 27 May 2027: announced third edition at the same venue. The event website calls the series “bisannuel”; the verified 2023/2025/2027 sequence establishes a two-year cadence, not annual recurrence. No destination or venue rotation is evidenced.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown. No edition-specific hotel, host hotel, room block, official housing bureau, hotel booking link, open accommodation RFP, peak-room figure or room-night figure was found in the reviewed organizer announcement, practical information, programme, contact and targeted French/English searches. Hotels listed: none found. This is not evidence of open sourcing, self-booking, or absence of private arrangements. Relevant source wording is “Lieu Palexpo” and, on the historical practical page, “HR LEVEL UP se tiendra le jeudi 12 juin 2025 de 8h à 14h, à Palexpo, Genève (centre de congrès).” Neither statement addresses lodging; there is no published lodging-sourcing statement to quote.
findings.organizationStructure: HR Genève is the nonprofit professional association organizing the event, not a travel-trade intermediary, PCO or DMC. Its statutes identify it as a Swiss Civil Code articles 60 et seq. association and HR Swiss member. Palexpo is the published venue; its role does not establish hotel-buying authority. No separately appointed housing agency or PCO was identified. Reclassify the seed segment as an association HR conference/networking event.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Palexpo has hosted both historical editions and is named again for 2027, creating a strong incumbent-venue relationship. Direct airport/station walking access competes with an off-site Founex stay. No competing hotel commitment, capacity shortage, sold-out hotel, overflow requirement or citywide compression was evidenced. Association membership exceeding 700 is not event attendance and must not become a room-demand proxy. No basis supports a 20–120-room block or whole-house use.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Rahel Alvarez first, copying or requesting introduction to Carola Oeuvray. Refer to 27 May 2027 at Palexpo and ask whether named nonlocal speakers, staff or attendees need rooms, who pays/books, whether a private housing agreement already exists, and whether Founex would be acceptable with a workable transfer plan. Request actual nights, peak rooms and arrival/departure timing before quoting. If no overnight need exists, close the 2027 accommodation path and retain an association relationship for separately sourced workshops. Escalate partnership discussion to Robert Tanner only if useful; do not propose replacing Palexpo.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: As of 17 November 2026, the next edition is confirmed for 27 May 2027 and the organizer says ticketing opens 27 November 2026. Event attendance access for members/nonmembers is distinct from hotel sales accessibility. The venue is already announced; accommodation sourcing and nonlocal overnight need remain unconfirmed. Treat as low-priority qualification/relationship outreach, not an open hotel RFP or confirmed overflow lead.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: repeated Palexpo use and the verified two-year cadence favor relationship-led ancillary lodging or independently commissioned smaller HR meetings over a main-event venue capture. No future venue competition or post-2027 date is announced in the reviewed sources. Do not label 2028 as a next edition, assign speculative dates, or present prospective ancillary business as existing demand.

suggestedOrsFollowUps: Ask the named organizer contacts to resolve overnight need, private housing arrangements and procurement ownership before treating this as sales-eligible accommodation demand.

Review the organizer announcement after 27 November 2026 and the programme during December for named speakers, travel or accommodation instructions; do not substitute the still-visible 2025 practical page for 2027 instructions.
If a genuine accommodation requirement emerges, obtain a quantified brief and confirm Founex transport acceptability and hotel catering requirements before proposal.
remainingUncertainties: Whether 2027 has any nonlocal overnight delegates, speakers or staff, and their actual arrival/departure dates, peak rooms, room nights and payer.

Exact 2027 attendance and Palexpo hall allocation are unpublished in reviewed sources.
